description: Helps navigate Android Settings efficiently using search.
instructions: In the Settings app, ALWAYS look for a search bar or search icon (magnifying glass) at the top/bottom of the screen. Tap it and use 'input_text' to search for the specific setting instead of scrolling manually in the home setting page. When you tap on it, you will see a keyboard appearing on the screen. Do not start typing on the keyboard. Use the tool 'input_text' and then use 'tap' tool to select the appropriate settings. Use the tool 'swipe' in order to see the hidden settings that are behind the keyboard.
